reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: high-entropy diborides are known to stabilize single phases and can lower sintering temperatures via sluggish diffusion and entropy stabilization, while multi-component oxide scales can improve oxidation resistance; the proposed mechanisms align with established high-entropy ceramic behavior.
reasons.testability: The test design is clear and includes appropriate characterization (XRD, SEM/TEM, hardness, TGA, corrosion mass loss) and a well-defined falsification criterion, though the exact liquid metal and oxidation conditions could be more specific.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the research question by proposing a single intervention (high-entropy alloying) that targets all stated limitations (processing temperature, strength, oxidation, liquid metal corrosion) and provides a practical, testable path forward.
